title: Ghost Again

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Activating KorēChant codex now.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: You came. I wondered if I’d ever see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You came. I wondered if I’d ever see you again.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: I’ve been thinking about you too. I can’t concentrate on anything else. I don’t listen during orations... all I can do is think about what you said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve been thinking about you too. I can’t concentrate on anything else. I don’t listen during orations... all I can do is think about what you said.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: I never thought you’d feel the same way. It's why I'm here. I'd risk anything to spend just another minute beside you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I never thought you’d feel the same way. It's why I'm here. I'd risk anything to spend just another minute beside you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I don’t think she can hear us. I believe she's reliving a conversation that already happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t think she can hear us. I believe she's reliving a conversation that already happened.
Or a memory.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: Do you remember the night we met? The night the Irisian Fall lit up the skies and turned the water into a sea of stars?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember the night we met? The night the Irisian Fall lit up the skies and turned the water into a sea of stars?
Shhh!

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: And when you looked at me and smiled, I knew you were my future. No matter what.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And when you looked at me and smiled, I knew you were my future. No matter what.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: I know, and it has to be soon. The order are holding a code cleanse and if they pick me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, and it has to be soon. The order are holding a code cleanse and if they pick me...

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: I snuck away from the chapter house and wanted to dive into that light. But when I looked down into the water, I saw you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I snuck away from the chapter house and wanted to dive into that light. But when I looked down into the water, I saw you.

nodes.speaker: The Ghost
nodes.text: I'll try to get away. Meet me in the gardens, by the stone. In four nights time. I’m trusting you, my love.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try to get away. Meet me in the gardens, by the stone. In four nights time. I’m trusting you, my love.
Ava, activate the codex.
You can hear me?
Umm...
Like an echo?
Ava, are you getting this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you hear me at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you hear me at all?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you hear me at all?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you hear me at all?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think we should be listening...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think we should be listening...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think we should be listening...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think we should be listening...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, let's leave.
Did we meet before?
I don't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's kinda cute. Still: Let's leave!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's kinda cute. Still: Let's leave!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's kinda cute. Still: Let's leave!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's kinda cute. Still: Let's leave!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sadly not much of a future.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sadly not much of a future.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sadly not much of a future.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sadly not much of a future.
